overview_description.description: Winden is a financial technology company that offers banking products for entrepreneurs and businesses. The company provides deposit banking, spend management, and other financial products for digital freelancers, agencies, and more. Its products are primarily aimed at single-person e-commerce businesses, but it also caters to digital freelancers and agencies. Winden offers digital entrepreneurs features such as free ACH, wire and check payments and the ability to manage transactions, payments and expenses in one place.

about_short_description.short_description: Winden is a financial technology company that offers banking products for entrepreneurs and businesses.

product.name: Winden AI-powered Business Credit Card
product.description: A business credit card that uses AI to maximize cash back rewards on every purchase automatically, offering 2% unlimited cash back and additional negotiated discounts.

product.name: Winden Scout™
product.description: An AI system that monitors transactions and automatically negotiates discounts and cash back rewards on business purchases.

product.name: Winden Business Account
product.description: A business account that enables receiving payments, sending money, and managing Winden cards with integrated invoicing and payment features.

product.name: Virtual Credit Cards
product.description: Virtual credit cards with customizable limits and merchant restrictions to control spending and prevent unauthorized charges.

product.name: Invoicing & Payments
product.description: A tool to manage customers, create customizable invoices, and facilitate quick payments with free domestic ACH and wire transfers.

product.name: AI CFO
product.description: An AI-driven accounting and financial projection tool that automates business accounting and forecasting.
